title: Camoufox Scraper
description: Camoufox Scraper loads Start URLs using Camoufox browser through Playwright and then executes Page function for each page to extract data from it. To follow links and scrape additional pages, set Link selector with Link patterns to specify which links to follow. Alternatively, you can manually enqueue new links in the Page function. For details, see the actor's README.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: A static list of URLs to scrape.

maxCrawlingDepth.title: Max crawling depth
maxCrawlingDepth.description: Specifies how many links away from the Start URLs the scraper will descend. Note that pages added using context.request_queue in Page function are not subject to the maximum depth constraint.

sleepTimeBeforeScreenshot.title: Sleep time before screenshot [s]
sleepTimeBeforeScreenshot.description: Specifies how long after navigation to the page screenshot is taken.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max requests per crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Crawler will stop after processing this amount of requests.

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout
requestTimeout.description: The maximum duration (in seconds) for the request to complete before timing out. The timeout value is passed to the httpx.AsyncClient object.

linkSelector.title: Link selector
linkSelector.description:
A CSS selector stating which links on the page (<a> elements with href attribute) shall be followed and added to the request queue. To filter the links added to the queue, use the Link patterns field.

If the Link selector is empty, the page links are ignored. Of course, you can work with the page links and the request queue in the Page function as well.

linkPatterns.title: Link patterns
linkPatterns.description: Link patterns (regular expressions) to match links in the page that you want to enqueue. Combine with Link selector to tell the scraper where to find links. Omitting the link patterns will cause the scraper to enqueue all links matched by the Link selector.

camoufoxPlugin.title: Camoufox Plugin
camoufoxPlugin.description: A Python code defining Camoufox plugin and all it's options.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Specifies proxy servers that will be used by the scraper in order to hide its origin.
